title: Treatment Options for Type 2 Diabetes in Adolescents and Youth (TODAY)
input_query: What are the study purpose, treatment interventions, risks, and participant responsibilities?
expected_answers: The study evaluates treatment options for type 2 diabetes in youth, comparing metformin alone, metformin plus rosiglitazone, and metformin plus intensive lifestyle intervention.
Participants must take prescribed capsules and attend scheduled study visits for monitoring.
expected_evidence: Metformin alone, metformin plus rosiglitazone, and metformin plus intensive lifestyle intervention
Adolescents and youth diagnosed with type 2 diabetes

title: PPAR-COMBO With Sulfonylurea
input_query: What are the main risks, eligibility criteria, and clinical procedures in this trial?
expected_answers: The trial evaluates PPAR-combo therapy combined with sulfonylurea in type 2 diabetes patients.
Risks include hypoglycemia, weight changes, and cardiovascular monitoring requirements.

title: Study of Different Doses of Sitagliptin in Type 2 Diabetes
input_query: What is the dosage of Sitagliptin and what clinical monitoring is required?
expected_answers: Sitagliptin doses are evaluated for glycemic control in type 2 diabetes.
Regular blood testing and renal function monitoring are performed.
